text: Really cute sandwich shop in a very cute neighborhood. Heard about this place on IG and the sandwiches sounded so good we had to try them. Upon arrival we thought it was an actual sit down restaurant but it was kind of like window service. The cashier was really nice and patient as I asked a million questions. I ordered the Kare Kare sandwich which was AMAZING! I could have eaten 2more. I also got the watermelon lychee smoothie and that was refreshing and the shrimp spring rolls. That was different because it had apples in it but it balanced it out to my surprise. Right next to the restaurant was a sitting area with plenty or tables and chairs. On a nice day it’s worth it to sit and enjoy your food in a nice area. I really enjoyed this place and want to come again. If you are in the area definitely pull up
label: recommendation

text: Be prepared to wait! Even if the line is short, the wait time for food was over 30 min . However, food was excellent. Sandwiches were very good. Grilled pork was a bit better than the special pork which was more like deli meat, but still tasty. Thai tea was also excellent. Highly recommend the pork and shrimp spring rolls, which were unique and one of the best I've ever had.
label: recommendation

text: Such a cute storefront for Vietnamese food. It’s right next to my church and I thought I’d try it today. My husband and I shared the grilled chicken and shaking beef bahn mi sandwiches. And boy were they fire!!! The meat was high quality and tender and juicy. The bread they used was amazing too, fresh and crunchy. You could tell all the ingredients they used were of high quality. Service was quick and staff were really nice. Highly recommend for a lunch stop!!
label: recommendation

text: We had just landed at the airport and needed lunch before driving north up the coast, and this little window punched far above its weight. The spicy tuna sandwich was fresh, flavor packed, and had delightful bread as well as a hearty kick. 10/10 no notes!
label: recommendation

text: Giant flavorful bahn mi’s with fresh ingredients. It’s big enough to split with two people but it was so good I devoured it myself in one sitting. My only gripe, the bread isn’t that soft. But that’s what happens when you eat a bahn mi sandwich sometimes. They have really great spring rolls too. Definitely worth the drive to lakeside.
label: recommendation

text: VERY expensive, very average banh mi. With this price tag, it should be the best banh mi I’ve ever had. Unfortunately, it’s not even close. Crispy roll and fresh ingredients, but very sparse meat, for the price. Too drippy. Tons of pickled carrots, but few other vegetables. The low rating is a reflection of how utterly average the sandwich is compared to the exorbitant price. Disappointing.
label: warning

text: Came across this place when visiting the area. Didn't know what it was besides a sandwich shop. Little hole in the wall type of place but the quality and atmosphere is more than that. Will definitely come again next time I'm in the area. Ate our sandwiches at the tables in the park next to it.
label: recommendation

text: It’s a bit pricey for a take out booth but the fresh spring rolls are full of cilantro and mint- becoming rare to find lately and the peanut sauce is deliciously thick and sweet.
label: neutral

text: It's a pretty decent banh mi for SF. I rate banh mi harsher because it's one of my favorite foods. It doesn't really come close to the banh mi shops in San Jose. The meats in this sandwich don't have all the traditional meat in there. The flavor is still really good though. I wish there was more radish to carrot ratio. The bread was ok and I'm grateful it didn't tear up the roof of my mouth.
label: neutral

text: Came here after a doc visit. Food is great. Many gluten free options. Springs rolls. They were able to customise my order and omit shrimp per my request as well. I added myshrooms to the chicken spring roll. Hearty portions! The thai coffee has dairy free option add on. Its a serious kick. Jolted. On a weekday this place was fast. Took about 7min from order to be ready. Next to a nice community garden. Got to see some hummingbirds feeding and singing.
label: recommendation

text: Incredible portion sizes. The bbq pork fried rice is so good!
label: recommendation

text: As a Chinese customer, I sincerely suggest to the owner that this restaurant needs significant improvements in both its food and service. The style of the food is quite American, which does not match its price. I ordered a fried rice and a soup. The fried rice was acceptable, but the soup was extremely unpleasant. I didn’t even finish it. When I was about to take a break and check my phone, the staff unexpectedly urged me to eat quickly. I really don’t understand this behavior. In short, I hope this restaurant can make changes and improve their food and service.
label: warning

text: This is a mystery place that looks super old with really good affordable Chinese food but no one except locals seem to go to. Anything fried, they do exceptionally really really well. Their fried rice is top quality and their ingredients are fresh. You can tell everything is freshly made. Ok so the dine in experience isn't the best. Their rundown indoor and table almost look like it could be dirty but they are not. You get a fresh pot of tea even if you dine alone and not many places in SF you can dine in for lunch under $15 that actually has food you want to eat. Oh forgot to mention their chili oil. Don't know it's in house or bought but it's so good. Not brunt and clear deep red with just the right amount of heat and flavor. Recommend.
label: recommendation

text: As someone else said earlier.. very basic Chinese restaurant in San Francisco. Ordered two meals.. one was a hit and one was a miss. Orange chicken was good and had good flavor and the sweet and sour chicken had no taste at all. Meal size was very large, staff was nice, price was reasonable for the area. Restaurant overall has seen its heyday a few years ago.
label: neutral

text: Cash-only Excelsior sit-down Chinese restaurant that offers huge portions for their lunch and dinner entrees at a fraction of usual city prices. My buddy and I got their lunch portion chicken fried rice, the General’s chicken, and two beers for only $28! The food came out quickly, the server was nice and quick and the food was really good! Bring your cash and an appetite.
label: recommendation

text: I been coming here and find it a very decent place to eat. Food is good and service is very friendly. I like it. Shall try it out..
label: recommendation

text: Always delicious food. Mongolian beef, bbq pork fried rice, sweet and sour pork, beef chow mein, tastes so good!
label: recommendation

text: Very good lunch specials. Their food is consistently good and the prices are really good. Most times, I get tea with my lunch special. Even when I get a coke, my bill is only $15, including a $2 tip. Highly recommended, and will continue to return to enjoy the items on the lunch special menu. They close at 3pm Monday through Saturday. They are closed on Sundays. Please be patient with the staff and remember to tip kindly...
label: recommendation

text: Very uncomfortable, unprofessional, I got sick The very next day. And they Couldn't get my order right both times. It's not fair to be Welcomed To One Of my Favorite Cultural dishes Asian cuisine and it's not what I imagined it to be. Honestly I would Go to Cambodian street food In Oakland,ca. It's a drive but Worth it... Happy New Years

text: I got a dish with rice at first I didn’t notice the smell after a few bites I noticed there’s a stale smell that rice gives off when it’s gone bad but I gave it the benefit of a doubt because the dish uses vinegar so I thought it might be the vinegar, but I got diarrhea after eating so I know that they gave me spoiled rice
label: warning

text: WOW! If you use the Too Good To Go app, this is a fantastic deal! For $5 I got 2 ginormous slices of pizza: one cheese and one Hawaiian. I heated them up a day later and they still tasted great. Thick crust with the right amount of chewiness and crunch. The man working there was really nice and let me pick up my surprise bag, even though I was 20 minutes early. The only negative thing, is there’s some sketchy people in the neighborhood, but sadly that’s the case for most of downtown San Fran.
label: recommendation

text: My stomach was touching my back and I was in need of a late night snack. I asked Gemini for a pizza spot open and offered good food. She opted on this one . I got directions and she routed me directly here . The staff was affable and engaging. Smiles and camaraderie abounding. Food was reasonably priced in this economy and was hot, fresh, and delicious. I stood at the convenient shelf outside on the sidewalk mixing with the flora snd fauna of O'Farrell St.
label: recommendation

text: They are very pleasant and have very tasty menu . Fast and good prices .

text: It's in a bad neighborhood, but don't let that bother you. It might look rough, but I've been there really late at night and have never felt unsafe. The pizza is good. The by the slice is reasonably priced and they accept EBT, but ONLY as long as you are registered as homeless. The fried oreos are awesome as long as you eat them while they're warm, and the chicken bbq pizza is really good. The crust isnt too thin or too thick. Its great comfort food and they are open until 3am. There is no place to sit. Its a walk up and go situation.
label: recommendation

text: Great Pizza spot and our favorite place to go! They have the best pizza crust and amazing customer service! Definitely recommend, try it for yourselves!
label: recommendation

text: For as much as I hate the the TL, I never mind coming here for a slice of a pizza or a whole one, premade slices are almost always fresh, some of the best quick pizza around, even better when you order fresh. Can't vouch for the other food.
label: recommendation

text: This is the best pizza in San Francisco and they're open extremely until 4:00 a.m. customer service is excellent and they are very accommodating you got to come here and try this stuff. The chicken is fire too

text: I eat here a couple times a week.Great food and friendly service. Open late night too which is AWESOME!

text: We had a very nice meal here. We had no reservation on a Friday evening, but we only had to wait 15 minutes or less. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The facility was excellent, cloth tablecloths and an upscale setting. The menu has a nice variety of sushi and small plates, which was very nice. The chicken yakatori was very tasty. The garlic edamame was really good and plentiful. The crab sushi roll was nice. The tempura is what changed this from 5 stars to four. Just one shrimp, and the items tasted like they had been battered and cooked earlier and then just reheated? I will go again, but I won’t order the tempura.
label: recommendation

text: Absolutely amazing, one of the best Japanese spots I’ve tried in a while. We stayed in Davis for 2 days and had to come back here for a second time. Very reasonably priced for the fresh ingredients and visual presentation.
label: recommendation

text: Excellent customer service and amazing menu with varieties of sushi. The big salmon sushi roll is good. The softshell crab is amazing. Reservation recommended on Weekend.
label: recommendation

text: Lovely contemporary izakaya restaurant in downtown Davis. They had many unique cocktails that elevated the ambiance and the food was good. Our main entrees which included the unagi don and chirashi were delicious, but the hamachi kama was on the drier side.
label: neutral

text: This spot is awesome! I came in after doing a long drive and a bum back for a late lunch and I got welcomed to a tranquil and modern dinning room. My waiter was great and helped me with menu. The grilled peppers with shrimp were a blast and perfect appetizer. The beef skewers were smoky and had a nice soy glaze and paired well with the grilled pineapple. The ramen stole the show for me with it's mellowness and depth of flavor and minor fountain of youth. When you are feeling super picky this spot will hit your expectations and more.
label: recommendation
